name: TRUSS SEO MCP — SEO Command Center
description: SEO Command Center for AI agents. Keyword research, site audits, content optimization, schema markup, SERP previews, and competitor analysis — all from your AI agent. No external API keys needed for basic analysis.

bearer.description: TRUSS license key (optional — basic analysis available without authentication)

skills.name: Keyword Research
skills.description: Analyze keyword opportunities, search intent, and competitive difficulty for target topics
examples: Research keywords for 'project management software' in the B2B SaaS space

skills.name: Site Audit
skills.description: Comprehensive technical SEO audit covering meta tags, headings, links, page speed indicators, and structural issues
examples: Audit https://example.com for technical SEO issues

skills.name: Content Brief Generator
skills.description: Generate detailed content briefs with target keywords, outline structure, and optimization recommendations (Pro)
examples: Create a content brief for a blog post targeting 'best CRM for startups'

skills.name: Schema Markup Generator
skills.description: Generate structured data / JSON-LD schema markup for articles, products, FAQs, local businesses, and more
examples: Generate FAQ schema markup for these questions about our product

skills.name: SERP Preview
skills.description: Preview how a page will appear in Google search results, with title and description length validation
examples: Preview the SERP appearance for my homepage meta tags

skills.name: Competitor Analysis
skills.description: Analyze competitor content strategies and identify keyword gaps and opportunities (Pro)
examples: Compare my SEO positioning against competitor.com for our target keywords
